# CirculateFiringNeuron

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking neuron model where the firing threshold circulates or rotates across the membrane potential dynamics, enabling more flexible spike timing and encoding. Enhances the temporal representational capacity of SNNs, critical for in-network neuromorphic processing where precise spike timing encodes information.
